test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A square park has an area equal to the area of a rectangle whose length exceeds its breadth by 9 m and the breadth is half the side of the square. Find the side of the square.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the side of the square be S.

Area of square = Area of rectangle ⇒ S² = (S/2 + 9) × (S/2)

Divide both sides by S: S = (S/2 + 9) ÷ 2

Multiply by 2: 2S = S/2 + 9 ⇒ 1.5S = 9

S = 9 ÷ 1.5 = 6 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 6 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of square park = Area of rectangle

Breadth of rectangle (B) = Side of square (S) / 2

Length of rectangle (L) = Breadth + 9 m

**Formula Used:**

Area of square = Side²

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6eba44d7b5ef61195c42e76ddf6eedc35cab9fb5897867aba02db32238b5b337.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the side of the square be S m.

⇒ Breadth of rectangle (B) = S/2 m

⇒ Length of rectangle (L) = (S/2 + 9) m

⇒ Area of square = Area of rectangle

⇒ S² = (S/2 + 9) × (S/2)

⇒ S² = S²/4 + 9S/2

⇒ Multiply the entire equation by 4:

⇒ 4S² = S² + 18S

⇒ 3S² − 18S = 0

⇒ 3S(S − 6) = 0

⇒ S = 6 m (Since side cannot be zero)

**∴ The correct answer is 6 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area and Perimeter of Square

Area = side² and Perimeter = 4 × side. The diagonal of a square is side × √2.

Area and Perimeter of Rectangle

Area = length × breadth and Perimeter = 2 × (length + breadth). The diagonal is √(length² + breadth²).

Unit Conversion

Always ensure all dimensions (length, breadth, side) are in the same unit (m, cm, etc.) before equating areas.
